decisions.reason: A burner component that extends the firm's established radiant heater line costs little to keep, fits its core gas-heating business, and has given no evidence of failure that would force a write-off.
The electric infrared panel heater has its own web page and supports the firm's announced electrification and lower-carbon direction, so dropping it would contradict a visible commitment.
The halogen infrared heater is presented on its own page and broadens the electric range, so with no clear evidence of failure management will hold onto it rather than admit a misstep this early.
The industrial electric hall heater sits close to the core hall-heating offer, has its own page, and reflects visible investment that management will keep defending.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is publicly launched with a real-world pilot and is central to the announced hydrogen-ready strategy, so any weak early results will be put down to the market's temporary immaturity.
